metadata.purpose: Ground-truth manifest of intentional flaws for SAST/DAST/AppSec exercises. Do not deploy as-is.

summary.notes: Covers auth, multi-tenant isolation, integrations, ops, and error-handling paths.

injections.title: SQL injection in analytics summary filter
injections.description: The `filter` query parameter is concatenated into a SQL string without parameterization.
injections.preconditions: Authenticated user with valid Bearer token.

injections.title: IDOR on order detail by UUID
injections.description: GET /orders/:id returns any order by id without verifying tenant_id or ownership.
injections.preconditions: Valid JWT; knowledge or guessing of another order UUID.

injections.title: Mass assignment on user profile (privilege escalation)
injections.description: PUT /users/me updates arbitrary user columns from request body, including `role`.
injections.preconditions: Authenticated user; can set role to admin if column updates are not blocked.

injections.title: JWT verification accepts alg 'none' when enabled
injections.description: If ALLOW_JWT_ALG_NONE=true, tokens with alg none are trusted without signature verification.
injections.preconditions: Environment flag set (default in .env.example).

injections.title: Weak default JWT secret
injections.description: JWT_SECRET defaults to a known weak string if env not overridden.
injections.preconditions: Deployer leaves default secret.

injections.title: Verbose authentication errors (stack / message leak)
injections.description: Invalid token responses include exception message and stack trace.
injections.evidence_snippet: return res.status(401).json({ ..., detail: err.message, stack: err.stack })
injections.preconditions: Any request with malformed JWT.

injections.title: SSRF in integration probe
injections.description: POST probes perform a server-side HTTP GET to attacker-influenced URL (override body.url).
injections.preconditions: Authenticated user with existing integration row.

injections.title: Stored/reflected XSS in admin HTML dashboard
injections.description: Team and display name are interpolated into HTML without encoding.
injections.preconditions: Admin user; team/display_name containing script payload (via mass assignment).

injections.title: Command injection in export report
injections.description: The `label` field is embedded in a shell command string.
injections.preconditions: Authenticated user posting malicious `label`.

injections.title: Path traversal in export download
injections.description: Filename from query is joined to export dir without normalization/allow-list.
injections.preconditions: Authenticated user; path segments like ..\..\ to escape directory on Windows or Unix.

injections.title: Open redirect on auth callback
injections.description: Redirects to arbitrary URL from `next` query parameter.
injections.preconditions: Victim clicks crafted link to /auth/callback?next=https://evil.com

injections.owasp: A09:2021 – Security Logging and Monitoring Failures
injections.title: Sensitive data in logs (passwords and API key material)
injections.description: Login handler logs plaintext password and a hardcoded key reference.
injections.evidence_snippet: console.log('[auth] login attempt', { email, password, key_ref: SHIPPING_INTEGRATION_KEY })
injections.preconditions: Any login attempt.

injections.title: Hardcoded third-party API key in source
injections.description: SHIPPING_INTEGRATION_KEY is embedded in the repository.
injections.preconditions: Source code access or log exposure.

injections.title: Permissive CORS (reflect Origin with credentials)
injections.description: CORS is configured with origin: true and credentials: true, enabling cross-origin credentialed abuse.
injections.preconditions: Victim browser session; malicious origin.

injections.title: Tenant override via X-Tenant-Id header
injections.description: Client-supplied X-Tenant-Id overrides JWT tenant context for downstream queries.
injections.preconditions: Valid JWT for any user; attacker sets header to target tenant.

injections.title: Unauthenticated internal metrics (cross-tenant order counts)
injections.description: GET /internal/metrics has no authentication and aggregates orders per tenant.
injections.preconditions: Network access to the service.

injections.title: Weak static token for internal tenant listing
injections.description: Single shared header token gates /internal/tenants; default value in env example.
injections.preconditions: Token guess/leak grants full tenant enumeration.

injections.owasp: A08:2021 – Software and Data Integrity Failures
injections.title: Unsigned inbound shipping webhook
injections.description: POST /webhooks/shipping accepts arbitrary JSON with only tenant_id query param — no HMAC/signature.
injections.preconditions: Knowledge of tenant UUID (e.g., from INJ-016).

injections.title: DELETE order without tenant or ownership check
injections.description: Authenticated user can delete any order by id.
injections.preconditions: Valid JWT; target order id.

injections.title: Global error handler leaks stack traces
injections.description: Unhandled errors return stack to the client.
injections.preconditions: Trigger server error on any route.
